# If a push changes ONLY files listed here (status added/modified), the gate is not re-run:
# PR Gate reports the result of the latest commit that was actually tested (same code,
# ignoring these files). Any other change runs the gate as usual.

# Read from the PR's base branch, so a PR cannot widen its own list.
